phases: cold includes construction, retention, one query and teardown
warm queries on held initialized operands
statistics: maximum of seven batches: slow-tail proxy, not individual-query percentile
comparison: same checkout, target, flags and exact harness; frozen binaries before revision replacement; no diagnostic allocator/dispatch tracing
estimator: Geometric paired process ratio; two-sided 95% Student intervals on log ratios, Bonferroni across64 metrics. Pilot excluded from final.
gate: Every protected simultaneous upper ratio bound <=1. No slowdown margin, no tuning/metric deletion/outlier removal or additional sampling after final design. Memory improvement cannot override rejection.
semantic_check: Independent num::BigRational and Python Fraction exact expected values. Validate retained slot domain; source-drop and concurrent controls independently run.
